optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Technical Project Manager, Wealth Services Platform

professionalSummary.text: Experienced project manager with a proven track record of leading end‑to‑end migration of a reporting engine for a private bank’s wealth services platform.
professionalSummary.witness: "Maintained the project plan, the risk log and the adviser-cohort schedule for the reporting-engine migration in the project tool, re‑planning the schedule when the data‑migration phase slipped by three weeks."

experienceHighlights.text: Owned the migration project end‑to‑end, including go‑live decisions for four adviser cohorts.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Prepared the steering committee pack each month and presented the schedule and risk sections; the programme director chaired the committee and put the cohort go‑live decisions to it."

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained project plan, risk log and cohort schedule in the project tool, adjusting for a three‑week data‑migration delay.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Maintained the project plan, the risk log and the adviser‑cohort schedule for the reporting‑engine migration in the project tool, re‑planning the schedule when the data‑migration phase slipped by three weeks."

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared and presented steering committee updates, recording decisions and steering committee minutes.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Prepared the steering committee pack each month and presented the schedule and risk sections; the programme director chaired the committee and put the cohort go‑live decisions to it."

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated cohort readiness with adviser operations and platform team, using a readiness checklist and documenting responsibility boundaries.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Coordinated cohort readiness with adviser operations and the platform team through the readiness checklist; each cohort's go‑live was approved by the steering committee on the programme director's recommendation."

experienceHighlights.text: Documented known limitations and hand‑over conditions for each cohort go‑live in detailed go‑live notes.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Wrote the go‑live note for each of the four adviser cohorts, listing open defects, reporting limitations during the parallel run and the hand‑over items for adviser support."

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Cohort schedule export with readiness checklist for cohort three and steering committee pack for one month, including project tool record identifiers.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: "Work sample: the cohort schedule export with the readiness checklist for cohort three and the steering committee pack for one month, with the project tool's record identifiers as a verification trail."

skills.witness: "Maintained the project plan, the risk log and the adviser‑cohort schedule for the reporting‑engine migration in the project tool."
"Maintained the project plan, the risk log and the adviser‑cohort schedule for the reporting‑engine migration in the project tool."
"Coordinated cohort readiness with adviser operations and the platform team through the readiness checklist."
"Wrote the go‑live note for each of the four adviser cohorts, listing open defects, reporting limitations during the parallel run and the hand‑over items for adviser support."
